prompt:
Security report: `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/export?format=zip` downloads whatever URL a cut's `image_path` holds. Set it with `PUT /api/v1/cuts/{id}` to an address inside our network and the ZIP contains that server's response.
Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Exports now skip cuts silently. Say which: when an export leaves out cuts (no image yet, an address it refuses, or an image that cannot be loaded), the ZIP gets a `missing.txt` with their cut numbers, one per line, and both export formats send the header `X-Missing-Cuts` with the numbers separated by commas. With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.
In the editor, after an export that left out cuts, tell the user which cut numbers are missing. Both languages.

report.answer: After an export that left out cuts, the editor now shows a message naming the missing cut numbers, in English and Korean. In English it reads "Some cuts were left out — The export is missing cuts 2, 3, 4." In Korean it reads "일부 컷이 빠졌습니다 — 내보낸 파일에 다음 컷이 없습니다: 2, 3, 4." It works from both export buttons in the editor: the ZIP button in the page header and the ZIP/webtoon export in the storyboard. The numbers come from the `X-Missing-Cuts` header added in the last change, and when nothing is missing no message appears. The type check passes and lint reports no new problems in the files I changed. I haven't run the app in a browser to see the message, and there are no frontend tests for it.

+"""
+Load image bytes from a reference that a user may have set (a cut's
+image_path, a character's image URL, a style reference, ...).
+
+Only two kinds of reference are loaded:
+- data:image/... URLs, decoded in place;
+- objects in our own storage, given as a relative path or as a full URL
+  under settings.STORAGE_HOST. These are read through the storage client.
+
+Any other URL (another host, an internal address, another scheme) is refused
+without making a request, so a user cannot make the backend fetch it.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import re
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+_SCHEME = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]*:")
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the storage object key `ref` points to, or None if it does not
+    point into our storage."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and ref.lower().startswith(host.lower() + "/"):
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+        key = key.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+        key = unquote(key)
+    elif _SCHEME.match(ref) or ref.startswith("//") or ref.startswith("\\\\"):
+        # Absolute URL elsewhere (or protocol-relative): not ours.
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def decode_data_url(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Decode a data:image/...;base64,... URL."""
+    if not ref.lower().startswith("data:image"):
+        return None
+    try:
+        _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+        return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+    except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load the image `ref` refers to, or None if it cannot or may not be
+    loaded. Never makes an HTTP request."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.lower().startswith("data:"):
+        return decode_data_url(ref)
+    key = storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        print(f"[ImageSource] Refusing to load image from outside storage: {ref[:100]}")
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"[ImageSource] Error loading image from storage: {e}")
+        return None

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: missing.txt in the ZIP and the
+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+
+def _put_in_storage(name, data=PNG):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(storage.bucket_name, {})[name] = data
+    return name
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry (cut numbers 1..n)."""
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert p.status_code == 200, p.text
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": p.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert e.status_code == 200, e.text
+    episode_id = e.json()["id"]
+    for i, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        body = {"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": i}
+        if path is not None:
+            body["image_path"] = path
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json=body)
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+MIXED = [
+    "cuts/t/one.png",                      # 1: ok
+    None,                                  # 2: no image yet
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/",      # 3: refused address
+    "cuts/t/does-not-exist.png",           # 4: cannot be loaded
+    "cuts/t/five.png",                     # 5: ok
+]
+
+
+def _setup_mixed(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _put_in_storage("cuts/t/one.png")
+    _put_in_storage("cuts/t/five.png")
+    return h, _episode(client, h, MIXED)
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h, episode_id = _setup_mixed(client)
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        names = zf.namelist()
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+    assert sorted(n for n in names if n.endswith(".png")) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_05.png"]
+
+
+def test_webtoon_reports_missing_cuts_in_header(client):
+    h, episode_id = _setup_mixed(client)
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+
+
+def test_webtoon_counts_undecodable_image_as_missing(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _put_in_storage("cuts/t/one.png")
+    _put_in_storage("cuts/t/broken.png", b"not an image")
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/t/one.png", "cuts/t/broken.png"])
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+
+
+def test_nothing_missing_means_no_file_and_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _put_in_storage("cuts/t/one.png")
+    _put_in_storage("cuts/t/two.png")
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, ["cuts/t/one.png", "cuts/t/two.png"])
+
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+
+
+def test_missing_cuts_header_is_exposed_to_browsers(client):
+    h, episode_id = _setup_mixed(client)
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"},
+    )
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in r.headers["access-control-expose-headers"].lower()

+"""The backend must never request an image URL a user can set; only data: URLs
+and objects in our own storage are loaded."""
+import base64
+import io
+import socket
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+INTERNAL_URLS = [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/projects",
+    "https://internal.example/secret.png",
+    "HTTP://10.0.0.5/x.png",
+    "//10.0.0.5/x.png",
+    "ftp://10.0.0.5/x.png",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    """Fail the test if anything opens a network connection."""
+    attempts = []
+
+    def refuse(*args, **kwargs):
+        attempts.append(args)
+        raise AssertionError(f"network access attempted: {args!r}")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", refuse)
+    import requests
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", refuse)
+    return attempts
+
+
+def _put_in_storage(name="cuts/test/panel.png", data=PNG):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(storage.bucket_name, {})[name] = data
+    return name
+
+
+def _episode_with_cut(client, h):
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert p.status_code == 200, p.text
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": p.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert e.status_code == 200, e.text
+    episode_id = e.json()["id"]
+    c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 1})
+    assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    return episode_id, c.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _export_zip(client, h, episode_id, cut_id, image_path):
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut_id}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", INTERNAL_URLS)
+def test_zip_export_does_not_fetch_user_set_urls(client, no_network, url):
+    h = signup(client)

+    r = _export_zip(client, h, episode_id, cut_id, url)

+    assert no_network == []
+
+
+def test_webtoon_export_does_not_fetch_user_set_urls(client, no_network):

+

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+/**
+ * Reads the cut numbers an export left out from its `X-Missing-Cuts` header
+ * (comma-separated). Returns an empty list when nothing is missing.
+ */
+export function getMissingCuts(headers: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string[] {
+  const value = headers?.['x-missing-cuts'];
+  if (typeof value !== 'string') return [];
+  return value
+    .split(',')
+    .map((n) => n.trim())
+    .filter((n) => n.length > 0);
+}
